# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Also, before we wrap this up, I need help with two other items too: I want to return a smart watch, and I want to return an e-reader I just bought. If the same e-reader is available online, I’d be willing to exchange it for the same item instead. If that’s not possible, then I’d want the 32GB storage E-Reader instead.

My name is Mei Ahmed, and my zip code is 78705. I don’t remember the email address on the order, unfortunately.
mei_ahmed_4909

- #W7553978

- the 2 skateboards
- the smart watch

- Mastercard ending in 9375 (`credit_card_5902940`)

Please tell me which order(s) contain those items, or if you'd like, I can help you look up the contents of each order one by one.

Thanks. I don’t remember which order has which item, so yes, please help me look them up one by one.

I’m trying to sort out:
- the 2 skateboards
- the smart watch
- the e-reader

And just to be clear, I do want the skateboard return refunded to the Mastercard ending in 9375. For the e-reader, I’d prefer an exchange to the same item if it’s available online, and if not, then the 32GB storage E-Reader.
